resolved_findings.previous_finding: The marker-only test could accept an unrelated manifest-state failure because its fixture was incomplete.
resolved_findings.resolution: The test now creates a complete temporary frozen suite with a synthetic approval, successfully loads that positive control, then changes only correction_approval.state to pending and requires ValueError. The manifest, receipt, candidate snapshots, review artifacts, inputs, and oracles remain available and valid. Removing the approval-state guard would let this negative load succeed, causing the test to fail rather than accept an unrelated rejection.

behavioral_assessment: The draft test still forces draft metadata independently of the live suite state, rejects before executable selection, and asserts that the output directory does not exist.
The marker-only test now checks the actual approval-state boundary without depending on exception wording or missing fixture content.

Reusing the existing complete fixture helper avoids a second synthetic approval convention. It creates its own test-only receipt and candidate snapshots, rather than treating historical receipts as current approval.
Both tests remain valid after the real suite is frozen. The draft test resets its local state; freeze_copy builds fresh synthetic approval metadata and a frozen manifest in a temporary directory.
No production inquiry execution is required. The marker-only test calls only the data loader; the draft test stops before repository preflight, executable resolution, or destination creation.
